lastCompletedStory.title: runIssueList command core: deterministic read + render + backend branch

nextStoryContext: runIssueList(options) is exported from src/commands/issue-list.ts: signature RunIssueListOptions = { cwd: string; configPath?: string; spawnFn?: BacklogSpawnFn; writer?: (s: string) => void; all?: boolean } -> number (always returns 0). US-003 (index.ts CLI wiring) should add issueListFn?: () => Promise<number> to IssueDispatchDeps, defaulting to an async wrapper calling runIssueList({ cwd: process.cwd(), all: parsed.all }) (runIssueList itself is synchronous; wrap in Promise.resolve() or an async fn for the dep-thunk shape shared with runIssueFn/fileLocalFn). parseIssueArgs (index.ts ~line 642) needs a new ParsedIssueArgs union member { mode: 'list'; all: boolean; help: false }: check args[0] === 'list' (with a --all flag scan over the rest) BEFORE the existing free-text fallthrough at the bottom of the function, so a bare 'list' positional is never misread as free-text issue creation. issue_system backend branching ('none' vs 'linear'/'github') is entirely internal to runIssueList already -- US-003 does not need to re-implement or duplicate that read. cam issue --help (ISSUE_HELP, index.ts ~line 256) needs a new line documenting 'list [--all]'. dispatchIssue's list branch must call ONLY issueListFn -- never runIssueFn or fileLocalFn -- to preserve the AC3 no-thin-proxy invariant.
